# ToolWools

> Free GTA 6 calculators, trackers, planners and guides — hardware checks, launch trackers, pricing and setup help, all in one place.

ToolWools publishes browser-based tools for Grand Theft Auto 6 players and PC builders. Estimates come from documented, published methodology; hardware and pricing figures are sourced and dated. No login, no paywall.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of all GTA 6 tools, trackers and guides.
- [All Tools](/tools): Searchable directory of every calculator, tracker and planner. 23 live tools, 1 more on the roadmap.
- [About](/about): Who runs ToolWools, editorial standards and contact routes.
- [Methodology](/methodology): How estimates, scores and hardware data are produced.
- [Guides](/guides): Explainers on FPS estimation and CPU/GPU pairing.
- [News](/news): Latest GTA 6 news and release updates.
- [Trailers](/trailers): Official GTA 6 trailer archive and breakdowns.
- [Trending](/trending): A seeded starter list of the tools most visitors need first. Not a usage ranking.
- [Trackers](/trackers): Release, pre-order and launch tracking tools.
- [Generators](/generators): Generate GTA 6 character names, crew tags, license plates, radio callsigns and gamertags — live, in your language.
- [Contact](/contact): Corrections, feedback and press enquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): What we collect, and what we do not.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms for using the site.
- [Editorial Policy](/editorial-policy): How ToolWools verifies numbers, handles corrections, and stays independent.
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): Not affiliated with Rockstar Games; estimates are projections.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap): Complete list of every page on the site, grouped by section.

## Tools

- [GTA 6 System Requirements Checker](/tools/system-requirements): Instant verdict against community-estimated Minimum, Recommended and Ultra tiers. GPU, CPU, RAM and storage.
- [GTA 6 Download Time Calculator](/tools/download-time): Estimate how long the 212 GB game install (plus 1.7–3.8 GB day-one patches) will take on your connection.
- [GTA 6 Storage Planner](/tools/storage-planner): Budget every gigabyte: base install, day-one patch, seasonal DLC and safe headroom for updates.
- [GTA 6 Release Date Reminder](/tools/add-to-calendar): GTA 6 launched Nov 19, 2026. Add the launch date to Google, Apple or Outlook calendar in one click. Launch status and local unlock times for 14 cities.
- [GTA 6 Readiness Score](/tools/readiness-score): One 0-100 launch-readiness score across performance, VRAM, storage and internet. Grade F to S with a weakest-link fix.
- [GTA 6 Bottleneck Calculator](/tools/bottleneck-calculator): Pick GPU + CPU. We detect the bottleneck for GTA 6 and suggest the smallest upgrade to fix it.
- [GTA 6 VRAM Requirements Checker](/tools/vram-calculator): Pick resolution and quality preset. Tool shows minimum VRAM needed and whether your GPU passes.
- [GTA 6 FPS Calculator](/tools/fps-calculator): Estimate frame rate for your GPU at 1080p, 1440p and 4K across Low, Medium, High and Ultra.
- [GTA 6 GPU Tier List](/tools/gpu-tier-list): S/A/B/C/D ranking of every GPU for GTA 6 performance. Searchable, filterable, updated on driver drops.
- [GTA 6 Interactive Map](/tools/interactive-map): Every named Leonida region on one schematic, tagged by evidence level, plus a size comparison against GTA V and RDR2.
- [Where to Buy GTA 6: Editions & Channels Compared](/tools/pre-order-tracker): Three buying channels scored on cancellability, price protection, download timing, bonuses and resale - for your platform and region.
- [GTA 6 Edition Picker](/tools/edition-comparison): What each edition actually unlocks in-game, tracked as Rockstar confirms it. Pricing lives on the price-by-country page.
- [GTA 6 Internet Speed Advisor](/tools/internet-speed-check): Grade latency, jitter, packet loss and speed against a realistic target for your region and device.
- [GTA 6 Price by Country](/tools/price-by-country): GTA 6 price in 44 markets, local currency and USD, tax split out. Includes the Standard vs Ultimate edition ladder.
- [GTA 6 Money & Business ROI Calculator](/tools/economy-calculator): Rank money methods by net $/hour, time any savings goal, compare business payback hours and price Shark Cards against the grind.
- [GTA 6 Launch Milestones](/tools/gta-6-tracker): GTA 6 launched Nov 19, 2026. The completed preload windows, launch milestones and the launch moment in your timezone.
- [GTA 6 Settings Optimizer](/tools/settings-optimizer): Dial in graphics settings for your target FPS and rig.
- [GTA 6 Hardware Comparison](/tools/hardware-comparison): Compare two GPUs or CPUs head to head for GTA 6.
- [GTA 6 Business Tracker](/tools/business-tracker): Track the 12 Leonida businesses, simulate payback with your own numbers, and compare story money methods. No business can be bought yet — every figure is labelled by source.
- [GTA 6 Preload History & Update Schedule](/tools/preload-tracker): GTA 6 preload history and update schedule: the launch preload (10–19 Nov 2026), title updates 1.002.000, 1.002.001 and the first post-launch patch 01.002.002 (23 Nov, with official notes). No DLC announced. Last checked 23 Nov 2026.
- [GTA 6 Weapon Comparison — Ratings, Magazine & Price](/tools/weapon-comparison): Compare the 53 base GTA 6 guns on Damage, Accuracy, Handling and Range — the four in-game ratings out of 10 — plus magazine size, fire mode and price. No fire-rate stat exists in the game; this tool shows the numbers the game shows. Last checked 24 Nov 2026.
- [GTA 6 Vehicle Comparison — Ratings, Register Cost & Sell Value](/tools/vehicle-comparison): Compare GTA 6 vehicles head-to-head on the five in-game ratings out of 10 — Speed, Acceleration, Asphalt Handling, Off-Road Handling, Strength — plus cost to register and sell value. No measured top speed exists yet; this tool shows the numbers the game shows. Last checked 24 Nov 2026.

## Roadmap

One more tool is in development and is not live yet: Server Status. They have no launch date promised. GTA 6 launched November 19, 2026.

## News

The five sourced items on the news page:

- May 2, 2025 — GTA 6 launch pushed to November 19, 2026 (Rockstar Games confirms a targeted release date of November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version.)
- May 6, 2025 — Trailer 2 reveals Jason, Lucia and a reborn Vice City (The second official trailer expands on the Bonnie-and-Clyde dynamic between Jason and Lucia, showcasing Leonida, the Everglades and a densely populated Vice City.)
- Dec 5, 2023 — Trailer 1: welcome to Vice City (Rockstar's first official reveal confirmed the Leonida setting, the dual-protagonist premise and a 2025 window that has since shifted.)
- Q3 2026 — Pre-orders expected to open a few months before launch (Rockstar has historically opened pre-orders roughly 3-4 months ahead of release. Editions, bonuses and pricing tiers have not been confirmed.)
- Ongoing — PC version: no dated window yet (Rockstar has not announced a PC release date. Following Rockstar's pattern with GTA V and RDR2, expect a gap of 6-18 months after the console launch.)

## Methodology in brief

Ten models, each with named inputs, a stated error band and a dated changelog. Reference rig: Intel Core i9-14900K, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24 GB, 64 GB DDR5-6400 CL32, Samsung 990 Pro 2 TB NVMe, Windows 11 24H2. Error bands include FPS ±15%, VRAM ±1 GB, bottleneck ±8 points, download time ±3%, storage ±15 GB. Full detail: /methodology.

## Analytics and privacy

Analytics is aggregate only and consent-gated: Google Analytics (GA4) loads only after a visitor accepts in the consent banner. Tool inputs never leave the device. Email addresses are collected only for the newsletter and contact replies, and are never sold. Full detail: /privacy.
